relative_comparison.violation_direction: Method B has MORE violations than Method A
relative_comparison.energy_direction: Method B uses LESS energy than Method A (19.6% savings)
relative_comparison.scientific_conclusion: Method B (Prediction-Guided NSGA-II) saves 19.6% energy by reducing compressor duty cycle, but this comes at the cost of 182.6% more thermal violations. The results demonstrate a genuine Pareto trade-off between energy efficiency and thermal safety, not a unilateral improvement. Method A is preferable when strict thermal compliance is required; Method B is preferable when energy cost reduction is prioritized and minor thermal excursions are tolerable.
